description: This file is a JavaScript source file used for generating C# API interface code from API documentation. It processes API definitions, types, enums, and generates corresponding C# classes, interfaces, and enums, including handling of documentation comments.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Generates a C# code file with documentation comments and class/interface/enum definitions based on provided specifications.

methods.name: renderClass
methods.description: Renders a C# interface class from a documentation class object, including its members and documentation.

methods.name: renderModelType
methods.description: Generates a C# class definition from a documentation type, handling properties and nested types.

methods.name: renderEnum
methods.description: Creates a C# enum from a list of string literals.

methods.name: renderOptionType
methods.description: Generates a C# class for API options, including constructors and properties.

methods.name: toArgumentName
methods.description: Converts a parameter name to a valid C# argument name, prefixing with '@' if needed.

methods.name: toMemberName
methods.description: Converts a member or method name to a C#-friendly name, adding 'I' prefix for interfaces and 'Async' suffix for async methods.

methods.name: toTitleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to TitleCase.

methods.name: renderConstructors
methods.description: Creates constructor overloads for a C# class, including copy constructors.

methods.name: renderMemberDoc
methods.description: Renders XML documentation comments for a class member.

methods.name: renderMember
methods.description: Renders a class property, method, or event with documentation and attributes.

methods.name: getPropertyOverloads
methods.description: Generates property overloads for different JSON representations.

methods.name: generateNameDefault
methods.description: Generates a default name for a type, considering enums, properties, and context.

methods.name: generateEnumNameIfApplicable
methods.description: Determines if a type can be represented as an enum based on its union of string literals.

methods.name: renderMethod
methods.description: Renders a method signature with parameters, async handling, and documentation.

methods.name: translateType
methods.description: Translates a documentation type into a C# type string, handling generics, arrays, objects, and special cases.

methods.name: registerModelType
methods.description: Registers a type in the model types map if it is not a primitive or option type.

methods.name: printArgDoc
methods.description: Outputs XML documentation for method parameters.

methods.name: toAsync
methods.description: Converts a method name to its async variant by appending 'Async'.

methods.name: rewriteSuggestedOptionsName
methods.description: Rewrites certain suggested option type names to a common 'Options' type.
